text: On the authority of Aisha - may God be pleased with him - she said: When the wind blew, the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, would say: O God, I ask you for its good, and the good of what is in it, and the good of what you were sent with, and I seek refuge in you from its evil, the evil of what is in it, and the evil of what you were sent with.
